utb_gross_ending_balance.why_hard: The row label 'Balance, end of period' is used by THREE different rollforward tables in this one filing, and the generic label carries no hint of which. One of the decoy tables is the valuation-allowance rollforward, whose value is field B of this very record.
decoys: L2961 'Balance, end of period | $ | 124,202 | $ | 102,250 | $ | 252,258' is the VALUATION ALLOWANCE rollforward - identical row label, 17 lines earlier, and its value is this record's field B.
L2432 'Balance, end of period | $ | 1,139,670 | $ | 1,139,670' is an unrelated rollforward, ~550 lines earlier.

L2980 prose says 'unrecognized tax benefits of $136.8 million and $126.8 million' - these are the IF-RECOGNIZED amounts, not the gross balance. The prose sentence reads as if it were stating the balance itself.
171,693 is the FY2023 ending balance and the FY2024 beginning balance.
L2882 'Valuation allowance | (7,493) | (0.25)' is a RATE-RECONCILIATION line printed 58 lines before the balance; the second number is a percent, not a dollar amount.
L2910 'Change in valuation allowance | 195.59 | (6.37)' is another rate-reconciliation line.
The same 124,202 also appears at L2961 as the ending balance of the valuation-allowance ROLLFORWARD - consistent, but a different table.
